structuredOutputs.uncertainties: The latest evidenced equity financing I found is the August 2022 public offering. Verona later disclosed ATM proceeds and significant debt/revenue-interest financings in 2024-2025, but those are not venture equity rounds and I did not find a later discrete equity round within the research limit. Lead investors in the 2022 offering were not identified; the source names underwriters/book-runners instead. Acquisition completion on 2025-10-07 is supported by the official Merck press-release URL/snippet from search results and by a current note on Verona's homepage; I did not directly open the Merck page, and Verona's current site is post-acquisition rather than a contemporaneous pre-close page.

outputs.reasoning: I resolved the entity from veronapharma.com, then checked a 2025 10-Q for listing status and acquisition announcement, and a 2022 GlobeNewswire release for the latest evidenced equity financing round found within the search limit. The 10-Q showed Verona was still Nasdaq-listed in August 2025 and had only announced a Merck transaction on July 8, 2025. I then used official/primary-source search-result evidence plus the company homepage's current note to establish that Merck completed the acquisition on October 7, 2025, which is before the 2026-09-30 cutoff. No later equity round than the August 2022 public offering was evidenced; later financing visible in snippets was debt/royalty or ATM proceeds rather than a discrete venture equity round.
